items.name: theme
items.title: Agentcard theme
items.description: The Agentcard tokens and the Tailwind names that read them.

site.--ds-font-display: "Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro", "Neue Haas Grotesk Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
site.--ds-font-mono: "Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro", "Neue Haas Grotesk Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

items.name: about-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for Agentcard company pages. Replace sample people, links and content.
constraints: Photos in color beside gray ones
More than one blue-bar directory per page
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/about; agentcard.sh /about (computed)
items.title: About page
items.description: About page template with a header, team directory, footer and navigation.

items.name: accordion
items.useFor: Use for FAQs or details that can stay collapsed. The InWindow example adds topic tabs and a containing window.
constraints: More than one list open by default
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.faq-list, .v7-page summary, .v7-page details > p); live https://www.agentcard.sh/ (#faq .faq-list, computed)
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable questions or sections with keyboard navigation.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.useFor: Use to confirm an action that cannot be undone or costs money (freezing a card, removing an agent). Give it a title that names the action and a description of the result. Put AlertDialogCancel first and AlertDialogAction last; use variant destructive on the action for removals. Pass name for the title bar and size sm for a short question.
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-windowbar), as the dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A confirmation in the brand's window: the sky title bar, a 24px display title, then Cancel and the action over a rule.

items.name: alert
items.useFor: Use default for a note (a new feature, a fact about a card), brand for an announcement that matters, destructive for a problem the person must act on. Give the bar a file-like name (voice.beta, agent.paused) or pass name={null} for a bare sheet. Lead with a lucide glyph; put one small key in AlertAction. It is shadcn's Alert API in the Banner's look.
constraints: More than one alert at a time
A filled red or blue sheet
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the Banner (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css .v7-guide-note, .v7-guide-cta-title) and the window bar (.v7-windowbar)
items.title: Alert
items.description: A note window: the sky, blue or rose bar labeled like a file over a sheet with a glyph, a display title, a muted line and an optional key.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.useFor: Use for product shots, screens inside windows and media previews so the layout does not jump while they load. Round and frame the media inside with the brand's 12px corners and hairline, or put it in a window.
items.source: Radix AspectRatio; framing from the brand's windows
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Holds an image or screen at a fixed shape while the width changes.

items.name: attachment
items.useFor: Use for files attached to a message, a purchase or a form: receipts, invoices, exports. Set state (idle, uploading, processing, error, done) and say what is happening in AttachmentDescription. Add AttachmentTrigger to open the file, AttachmentAction for remove, retry or download, and AttachmentGroup for a row that scrolls.
constraints: More than two actions on one file
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the white key (agentcard-website .v7-btn), the window bar's sky and blue (.v7-windowbar) and the guides' light bevel
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file on a small white key: a sky tile with a blue glyph, the name in the display face and its size or status below; dashed while waiting, red when it failed.

items.name: avatar
items.useFor: Use beside a person’s name or role. Provide alt text on AvatarImage. Use size="lg" for larger profiles.
constraints: A ring or border around the photo
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/company-page.tsx (PersonCard), src/app/globals.css (.v7-about-cell img, .is-founders .v7-about-cell img); live https://www.agentcard.sh/about
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Square grayscale photo with an initials fallback.

items.name: badge
items.useFor: Use tag, tag-ink and tag-heart for added, improved and fixed updates. Use status variants for state and chip for counts or filters.
constraints: Caps on anything but the tag
More than one tone per row
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-upd-tag, .is-added, .is-improved, .is-fixed; .v7-guide-prose code for the chip); live https://www.agentcard.sh/updates
items.title: Badge
items.description: Labels for status, categories and counts.

items.name: band-divider
items.useFor: Use where blue sections meet white or paper. Hero, SiteFooter and Cta already include their dividers.
constraints: A divider between two sections on the same ground
Grain anywhere else on the page
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/band-divider.tsx; src/app/globals.css:527 (.band-divider, .band-step); agentcard.sh / (computed)
items.title: Band divider
items.description: Stepped divider between page backgrounds.

items.name: banner
items.useFor: Use info for general notices, brand for announcements and alert for problems. Set name for the title bar and provide an action when one is needed.
constraints: More than one banner at a time
Banners for marketing copy that belongs in a section
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-note, .v7-guide-note-body, .v7-guide-cta-title, --guide-shadow); src/components/v7/guide-body.tsx (note)
items.title: Banner
items.description: Notice with a title, message and optional actions.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.useFor: Use above a page title in deep sections (Agents, Travel agent, Cards). Keep the trail short; collapse the middle with BreadcrumbEllipsis.
constraints: Separators other than the chevron or a slash
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard (the guides' 12px display labels)
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail in the 12px display face: muted links, faint chevrons, the current page in ink.

items.name: bubble
items.useFor: Use inside Message for a conversation with an agent: default (blue, align end) for what the person sends, secondary for the agent's replies, tinted for another agent, muted for a system note, outline for a quote, destructive for a message that failed, ghost for long output without a box. Group consecutive bubbles with BubbleGroup so only the last keeps its tail.
constraints: More than two bubble colors in one thread
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the blue key (agentcard-website .v7-btn-primary), the quiet gray and paper grounds and the cards' 12px corners
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A message bubble: the person's in the electric blue with white text, the agent's on the pale gray, 12px corners with a square tail corner.

items.name: button-group
items.useFor: Use for related actions that act on the same thing (Previous and Next, Copy and Download) or a field joined to its action. Use secondary keys inside, ButtonGroupText for a label segment, and ButtonGroupSeparator between blue keys.
constraints: Mixing primary and secondary keys in one group
More than five keys in a bar
items.source: Extrapolated from the brand's keys (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css --bevel)
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Keys joined into one bar with merged edges, with an optional sunken text segment.

items.name: button
items.useFor: Use one primary action per section. Use secondary for other actions, on-brand on blue backgrounds and ghost in toolbars. Wire an onClick handler, use type="submit" for forms, or use asChild with a link for navigation.
constraints: Two blue keys side by side for equal actions
A gradient or glow on a key
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css:4159 (V7 buttons and tabs, one bevel)
items.title: Button
items.description: Buttons for primary, secondary, toolbar and on-blue actions.

items.name: calendar
items.useFor: Use inline to pick a date, several dates or a range (mode single, multiple or range) and inside DatePicker for a field. Pass disabled to block days (weekends, past days) and captionLayout="dropdown" for dates far away.
constraints: A selected color other than the blue key
items.source: Extrapolated from the brand's keys and tab track (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css --bevel, .plan-tabs)
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid of 36px cells; chosen days are blue keys and a range sits on a pale blue band.

items.name: card
items.useFor: Use default for features, plans or quotes. Use raised for product content with a preview. Use Window when the container needs a title bar.
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-trail li, .v7-sol); live https://www.agentcard.sh/
items.title: Card
items.description: Container for related content, with default and raised variants.

items.name: carousel
items.useFor: Use to browse a few items of the same kind (card designs, merchant logos, receipts). Wrap CarouselItem in CarouselContent and add CarouselPrevious and CarouselNext; use setApi to show the position.
constraints: Essential content only on later slides
More than one carousel in view
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard (button.tsx white key, marquee rows)
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides that snap into place with white keys to move between them.

items.name: chart
items.useFor: Use to show spend or activity over time (BarChart, LineChart, AreaChart) or a share of a whole (PieChart). Wrap the chart in ChartContainer with a config that names each series (colors default to series-1 to series-4), then add ChartTooltip and ChartLegend. Give every chart an aria-label. Legend items toggle their series; arrow keys move the tooltip.
constraints: Charts that animate again on every update
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the series tokens, the tooltip (agentcard-website .v7-tooltip) and the display face's small print
items.title: Chart
items.description: Bar, line, area and donut charts in SVG, in the brand's four series colors, with the guides' white tooltip and a display-face legend.

items.name: checkbox
items.useFor: Use for multiple selections or a single agreement. Pair it with Label. When passing checked, update it through onCheckedChange.
constraints: Colors other than blue for checked
A checkbox for an action that happens at once (use a switch)
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (--bevel-blue, --bevel-muted)
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked, indeterminate and disabled states.

items.name: code-block
items.useFor: Use for code a person reads or copies: SDK calls, curl commands, API responses. Give it a CodeBlockHeader with CodeBlockTitle (the file name, or Terminal) and a CodeBlockCopyButton, then CodeBlockContent with the code. Pass wrap for long values and a max-h class for long files. It is shadcn's CodeBlock API in the CodeWindow look; on a page it sits on a blue panel as on the home page.
constraints: A full syntax theme with many colors
items.source: Agentcard code window: agentcard-website src/components/v7/integrations.tsx (CodePane), src/app/globals.css (.v7-intg-code); agentcard.sh / (computed)
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code on the ink ground, as the code window draws it: a bar with three squares, a file name and a copy key, then light highlighting and line numbers.

items.name: code-window
items.useFor: Use for commands, integration examples and API requests. Pass code as a string for highlighting and copying, or pass rendered children.
constraints: A full syntax theme with many colors
Code set in a monospace other than the display face
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/integrations.tsx (CodePane), src/app/globals.css:3341 (.v7-intg-code); agentcard.sh / (computed: .v7-intg-stage [class*=code])
items.title: Code window
items.description: Code block with a filename, highlighting and optional copy action.

items.name: collapse
items.useFor: Use for optional form fields, settings or details. Connect open to state and give the trigger aria-expanded and aria-controls.
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (the FAQ's slide, .faq-list details::details-content)
items.title: Collapse
items.description: Expandable content area that animates its height.

items.name: collapsible
items.useFor: Use to hide secondary detail under a row (more card settings, a purchase's line items). Put a CollapsibleTrigger (often asChild on a button) and CollapsibleContent inside Collapsible; control it with open and onOpenChange when needed.
constraints: A trigger without a visible state
items.source: collapse.tsx (agentcard-website plan details)
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A disclosure that grows open and shut with the brand's 300ms ease-out.

items.name: combobox
items.useFor: Use for one or several choices from a list too long to scan (merchants, agents, currencies). Compose ComboboxTrigger (or ComboboxChips for several values), ComboboxContent, ComboboxInput, ComboboxList and ComboboxItem. Give it a name to submit the chosen values.
constraints: A combobox for under six options (use a select)
Filtering that hides the chosen value without saying so
items.source: Extrapolated from agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field select) and agentcard-website src/components/v7/guide-search.tsx
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable choice: the square field opens the floating panel with a search row and washed rows.

items.name: command
items.useFor: Use Command for an inline list and CommandDialog for a palette. Connect each CommandItem onSelect to navigation or an action. Bind the dialog to Cmd/Ctrl K when needed.
constraints: A drop shadow on the panel
Icons in every row instead of a title and a line
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/components/v7/guide-search.tsx; src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-search-layer, .v7-guide-search-panel, .v7-guide-search-field, .v7-guide-search-results, .v7-guide-search-group, .v7-guide-search-keys)
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable command list or dialog with keyboard navigation.

items.name: context-menu
items.useFor: Use for shortcuts on a row or an object (a purchase, a card) that are also reachable elsewhere. Group rows with separators and labels, mark the destructive row with variant destructive, and show shortcuts with ContextMenuShortcut.
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard (dropdown-menu.tsx)
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu drawn as the brand's menu: a white floating panel with display-face rows.

items.name: copy-button
items.useFor: Place beside a command, key or ID and pass its value. Use a label that identifies what will be copied.
constraints: A copy button without a label for screen readers
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/command-copy.tsx; src/app/globals.css (.v7-command)
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies text with success and failure feedback.

items.name: cta
items.useFor: Use near the end of a page when another action is needed. Provide a working link or handler for the action.
constraints: A blue key on the blue
A gradient or glow behind the headline
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css:1288 (.cta, an earlier closing stage); built from the hero's ground and the band divider (agentcard.sh has no closing CTA)
items.title: CTA
items.description: Blue section with a heading, action and optional media.

items.name: data-table
items.useFor: Use for records people sort, filter and act on (purchases, cards, agents). Pass columns (header, accessor, cell, sortable), data and getRowId. Add selectable for bulk actions and pageSizes to let people choose rows per page; put actions in toolbar.
constraints: More than one table per page without headings
items.source: Built on table.tsx (agentcard-website .v7-guide-table)
items.title: Data Table
items.description: The brand's ruled table with a search field, sortable heads, row selection, a Columns menu and page keys.

items.name: date-picker
items.useFor: Use DatePicker for one date (a card's expiry, a report day) and DateRangePicker for a period (spending from and to). Add presets for common choices and name to submit the ISO dates with FormData.
constraints: A free-text date without a calendar
Keeping the panel open after a single date is picked
items.source: Extrapolated from agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field select) and the brand's floating panel
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A square date field with a blue calendar mark that opens the calendar in the floating panel.

items.name: dialog
items.useFor: Use for a short form or confirmation. Provide a title and description. Set name for the title bar and size for wider content. Connect form submission and validation to the application.
constraints: A dialog opened from another dialog
Sliding in from an edge (use a sheet)
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-windowbar); src/components/v7/window-mark.tsx
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with a title bar, focus trap and close control.

items.name: direction
items.useFor: Wrap a right-to-left page or region in DirectionProvider dir="rtl" (and set dir on the element) so menus, sliders, tabs and the segmented track flip. Read it in a component with useDirection.
items.source: Radix DirectionProvider; no visual of its own
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left reading for every Radix component inside it.

items.name: docs-link
items.useFor: Use to link to a guide or reference in a new tab. Provide the destination URL and a descriptive label.
constraints: Arrows on links that stay on the site
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (links); live https://www.agentcard.sh/
items.title: Docs link
items.description: External documentation link with an arrow.

items.name: drawer
items.useFor: Use on phones for a short task tied to the page: choosing a card, reviewing a purchase. Set direction (bottom by default). Put the title in DrawerHeader and the actions in DrawerFooter. Mark scrolling areas inside with data-drawer-no-drag.
constraints: Dragging that fights a scrolling list
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard (the sheet window, the ink scrim)
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel pulled from an edge: the brand's white window with a grab handle, dragged away or flicked shut.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.useFor: Use for actions on an item or a compact navigation menu. Set variant="glass" on blue backgrounds. Use onSelect for actions and DropdownMenuHoldItem for destructive actions that require a hold.
constraints: Menus for navigation that should be visible
More than one level of submenu
A destructive row that fires on one click
items.source: https://agentcard.com/ (.v7-dock-card); white menu and extra item types are extensions
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Action menu with standard and glass panels, submenus and selection controls.

items.name: empty-state
items.useFor: Explain what is missing and provide the next action. Set name for the title bar or null to hide it. Connect actions such as creating an item or clearing a search.
constraints: Empty states that blame the reader
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-windowbar)
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Message and optional action for an empty list or search result.

items.name: empty
items.useFor: Use when a list, a search or a view has nothing to show: say what is missing and give the one next action (New card, Clear search). Name the bar like a file (cards.list, search.results) or pass name={null}. It is shadcn's Empty API in the EmptyState look; use EmptyMedia variant icon for a lucide glyph.
constraints: Empty states that blame the reader
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the EmptyState (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css .v7-windowbar) and the white key (.v7-btn)
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty list as a quiet window: the sky bar, a centered key glyph, a display title, one muted line and one action on the pale ground.

items.name: faq
items.useFor: Pass title, lead and topics containing questions and answers. A single topic hides the tabs. Set bar to label the window.
constraints: Answers longer than a short paragraph
A chevron in place of the drawn +
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/faq.tsx, src/app/globals.css:932 (.faq2, .faq-list); agentcard.sh / (.faq-card, .faq-tabs, .faq-list, computed)
items.title: FAQ
items.description: FAQ section with optional topic tabs and expandable answers.

items.name: feature-rows
items.useFor: Use FeatureRows for the main feature list and FeatureGrid for supporting details. Supply a screen or illustration for each feature.
constraints: More than one blue key per row
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/feature-rows.tsx; agentcard.sh/vault and /issuing (computed: .v7-feat, .v7-feat-stage, .v7-feat-pill, .v7-feats.is-4)
items.title: Feature rows
items.description: Product feature layouts with text and media.

items.name: field
items.useFor: Wrap Input, Textarea, TagsInput or SelectTrigger. Derive error from the current value and clear it when valid. Use required for required fields and htmlFor when the control has an explicit id.
constraints: Labels inside the field as placeholders
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-gate-field); live https://www.agentcard.sh/get-started
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, help text, error message and accessibility attributes for a form control.

items.name: form
items.useFor: Use for a form with validation managed by react-hook-form: wrap it in Form, render each field with FormField, and place FormLabel, FormControl (around one control), FormDescription and FormMessage inside a FormItem. For a single field without react-hook-form, use Field.
constraints: Validating on every keystroke before the first submit
items.source: agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field, computed)
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form fields laid out as the brand's get-started form: display labels, square fields, red messages.

items.name: hero
items.useFor: Use at the top of an Agentcard home or product page. Put SiteHeader in header and background imagery in background. Use titleClassName to adjust title sizing or wrapping.
constraints: A blue key on the blue
A smooth fade into the page instead of the bands
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/immersive-hero.tsx; src/app/globals.css:4100 (.v7-immersive, .v7-pricing-scan); agentcard.sh / (computed)
items.title: Hero
items.description: Page opening with a blue background, heading, actions and optional media.

items.name: hold-button
items.useFor: Use for destructive actions such as closing a card. Connect onConfirm to the action. Releasing early, leaving the control or losing focus cancels the hold.
constraints: Hold for actions that can be undone
A blue fill for a destructive action
items.source: Extension from agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (--bevel-white); principles (keys sink on press)
items.title: Hold button
items.description: Button that confirms an action after a continuous hold.

items.name: home-page
items.useFor: Use as a starting point for an Agentcard landing page. Replace sample content and media, and check every link.
constraints: Blue grounds stacked between the hero and the footer
A window bar on every card
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/page.tsx; agentcard.sh / (computed)
items.title: Home page
items.description: Home page template with product sections, integrations, FAQ and navigation.

items.name: hover-card
items.useFor: Use to preview what a link points to (an agent, a merchant, a card) without leaving the page. Keep the content short and repeat anything essential on the destination: touch and keyboard users may never see it.
constraints: Opening on every passing hover (keep the delay)
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard (the popover panel)
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview in the brand's floating panel that appears while the pointer rests on a link.

items.name: input-group
items.useFor: Use when a field needs a unit, a prefix, a status or an action inside its border: an amount in USD, a domain, a Copy key on an API key, a search mark. Use InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea as the control and InputGroupAddon (align inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end) around it.
constraints: A second border inside the group
items.source: Extrapolated from agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field input) and the brand's keys
items.title: Input Group
items.description: The square field with labels, marks, a sunken segment or small keys inside it.

items.name: input-otp
items.useFor: Use for a short code sent by SMS or email (sign-in, a card reveal). Set maxLength and pattern={REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS}, group the slots with InputOTPGroup and split long codes with InputOTPSeparator. Paste and SMS autofill fill every slot.
items.source: Extrapolated from agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field input)
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Joined square slots in the brand's field for a one-time code, the active slot outlined in blue.

items.name: input
items.useFor: Use inside Field for a label and validation message. Set an appropriate input type. Use variant="search" for search or filtering and connect changes to the results.
constraints: Rounded form fields (only the search box has corners)
Placeholder text as the only label
A glow or ring on focus (the brand draws the outline)
items.source: agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-gate-field input, .v7-guide-search); live https://www.agentcard.sh/get-started (computed)
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field with standard and search variants.

items.name: integrations
items.useFor: Pass rows with a title, description and options. Each option supplies a label, icon and panel. Use IntegrationCode and IntegrationScreen to build the preview.
constraints: More than six tools in one row
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/integrations.tsx; agentcard.sh / (.v7-intg-row, .v7-intg-tab, .v7-intg-stage, computed)
items.title: Integrations
items.description: Integration sections with selectable tools and matching previews.

items.name: item
items.useFor: Use for rows in a list a person scans or picks from: cards, agents, merchants, updates. Set aria-current or data-selected on the current row (it turns pale sky with a blue title). Use outline for a row that stands alone as a card, muted for a row on the gray ground, size sm or xs for dense lists, and ItemHeader or ItemFooter for a date or a tag.
constraints: More than two lines of description
items.source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the guides' nav rows (agentcard-website .v7-guide-nav), the updates feed (/updates), the white key (.v7-btn) and the team page's photos (/about)
items.title: Item
items.description: A list row: a blue glyph in a small key or a square photo, a display-face title over a muted line, and actions at the right.

items.name: kbd
items.useFor: Use in control hints, menu items and command palette instructions. The bare variant is for compact search hints.
constraints: Keys for things that are not keys
Keys in body copy larger than the text around them
items.source: Repository reference; public guide pages currently unavailable. agentcard-website src/app/globals.css (.v7-guide-search-keys kbd, .v7-guide-search kbd)
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key or shortcut label.

items.name: label
items.useFor: Use the default form label above an input. Use variant=control for the larger label beside a checkbox, switch or radio. Connect htmlFor to the control id, or use Field to connect it automatically.
constraints: Labels without a control to point at
items.source: https://agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field > span); control variant is an extension
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible label for a form control.

items.name: logo-strip
items.useFor: Pass customer names and logos. Use the optional tone for the title bar. The layout adapts to the number of customers and screen width.
constraints: Bars in colors other than the five tints and sky
Links or buttons inside the windows
items.source: agentcard-website src/components/v7/products-showcase.tsx (Customers); agentcard.sh / (.v7-customers, .v7-customer, computed)
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: Customer logos in a responsive grid of small windows.

items.name: logo
items.useFor: Use Lockup in headers and footers, and LogoMark in smaller spaces. Set label={null} when the containing link already has an accessible name.
constraints: The logo in a color other than blue
A drop shadow or glow behind the logo
